candidates.value: Corsair Flash Voyager V2 128GB USB 3.0 Flash Drive
• Durable rubber housing• Water resistant• Shock proof• Backward compatible with USB 2.0• Warranty: 5 Years

As fast as USB flash drives are, copying files always seems to take a little longer than you'd like. The advent of the USB 3.0 interface puts an end to that. You can move files back and forth in a fraction of the time it takes with standard USB 2.0 flash drives, and the proprietary water-resistant rubber housing helps keep those files safe. Of course, Flash Voyager USB 3.0 is backward compatible with USB 2.0. Even if you haven't yet upgraded your PC to USB 3.0, it's still a great choice for convenient, reliable portable file management, and the additional performance will be ready when your PC is. The finger-friendly ergonomics of the Flash Voyager USB 3.0 will make it the USB flash drive that you'll want to take with you everywhere. Reliability is essential. Corsair's proprietary all-rubber housing is extremely durable, for worry-free transport of your valuable data. And because accidents happen, Flash Voyager USB 3.0 is water-resistant. Unlike traditional storage media, flash drives are solid-state, so they can easily handle the everyday - and not so everyday - drops and bumps that come with the territory.
